elements.text: 4 of 5 material-plants checked are healthy with no shortfalls or safety stock breaches (MP-1010-8892, MP-1020-7400, MP-1020-8891, MP-1030-8892). · Assumptions: analysis date: 2026-09-04 (index.md); order processing time: 2 days from deciding to buy until the PO is with the vendor (rules/alerting.md); transfer lead time: 2 days (rules/transfer-limit.md); near-term horizon: today + order processing time + avgLeadTimeDays of the vendor on the material-plant's open supply; if none, the shortest lead time among eligible approved vendors; if none is eligible, the longest lead time among approved vendors (rules/alerting.md); same-day ordering: demand is subtracted before supply is added on the same date (concepts/projected-stock.md); backlog: the balance may go negative; a missed requirement is still owed, and later supply fills it first (concepts/projected-stock.md); type decides commitment: requirementType decides committed (ProductionOrder, SalesOrder); priority only ranks within committed demand (concepts/committed-demand.md); north of ninety percent: strictly greater than 0.90 (rules/vendor-eligibility.md); alternate vendor price: unknown; premium to be quoted (rules/spending-policy.md)
